Acquire / Manage / Finance

Alourde Group is the parent of three specialized businesses spanning investment and management, development, and capital. Instead of treating each discipline like a separate handoff, the firm looks at the opportunity as one connected transaction.

How We Work

From sourcing to oversight.

The firm does not force every opportunity through the same checklist. The work follows the property, the investor and the execution plan.

Source

On-market and off-market opportunities are screened for fit before they reach investors.

Underwrite

Pricing, downside, upside and execution requirements are reviewed before an opportunity moves forward.

Execute

Acquisition, financing, diligence and operational setup are coordinated around the actual transaction.

Oversee

After closing, the focus shifts to visibility, operations and protecting the business plan.

Deal Intake

Put the property
in front of us.

Owners, agents, brokers and wholesalers can submit real estate opportunities for review.

What We Review

Clear facts move faster.

Market, asset type, asking price, occupancy, rehab, timeline and supporting documents all help the team evaluate the opportunity efficiently.

Mortgage

Financing that fits
the transaction.

Capital coordination is approached as part of the deal strategy, not as a separate step at the end.

Capital Coordination

Structure first. Rate second.

The objective is to identify financing options that align with the borrower, property, timeline and investment plan.

  • Loan scenario review
  • Pre-approval coordination
  • Lender network access
  • Closing support
Loan Programs

Financing options for different deal structures.

The capital side supports a range of investor and real estate financing needs. Program fit depends on property type, borrower profile, deal structure and lender guidelines.

01

DSCR Loans

Rental-property financing based primarily on property cash flow.

02

Hard Money Loans

Short-term financing for acquisitions, flips and time-sensitive opportunities.

03

Private Loans

Private capital options for investors needing flexible execution.

04

Construction Loans

Financing support for ground-up development and major build projects.

05

Rehab / Renovation Loans

Capital for repairs, improvements and value-add execution.

06

Bridge Loans

Short-term financing to bridge timing gaps between acquisition, stabilization, refinance or sale.

07

Fix & Flip Loans

Investor financing for purchase, renovation and resale strategies.

08

Portfolio Loans

Financing options for investors with multiple rental properties.

09

Commercial Real Estate Loans

Financing support for multifamily, mixed-use, retail, office, industrial and other income-producing assets.

10

Refinance / Cash-Out Options

Loan options to refinance existing properties or unlock equity for future investment.
